recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast composition featuring a central black paper-cut silhouette of a stylized wolf head and shoulders against a vast white field, accompanied by raw, hand-lettered text on a simulated tape strip.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized subject against expansive negative space
Rough, jagged edges of the silhouette contrasting with the clean white background
Hand-drawn white facial features within the black silhouette
Text anchored directly below the subject on a horizontal axis
coreInvariants: Visible paper texture and slight imperfections (dust/specks)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 30% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black silhouette of the wolf.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the high-contrast wolf silhouette, drops to the text strip immediately below, then expands to the white negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white space surrounding the central cluster, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background providing a clean, stark canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the primary subject and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/light grey for paper texture and dust artifacts.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between black and white.

letterConstructionRules: Letters contained within a faint rectangular border resembling a label or tape strip
Varied baseline and kerning for a DIY feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly distorted as if drawn on a textured surface
The 'O' and 'A' have filled or nearly-filled counters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style hand-lettering to maintain a raw, singular voice.

preserve: Black ink on white paper look

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the DIY, lo-fi aesthetic of the original
Matches the jagged edges of the paper-cut wolf

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a stark white background with subtle paper grain and occasional black dust specks. In the center, place a black paper-cutout silhouette of a wolf's head and shoulders with jagged, irregular edges. Inside the black silhouette, add simple white hand-drawn eyes, a nose, and a snarling mouth with sharp teeth.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of hand-drawn, black, uppercase block lettering centered directly beneath the wolf silhouette. Enclose the text in a very faint, thin-lined rectangular box that looks like a piece of clear tape or a label.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white with only minor texture?
Does the wolf look like a physical paper cutout?
Is the text hand-drawn rather than a standard font?
Is the composition centered with significant negative space?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the wolf to avoid direct copying
Exact letter shapes while maintaining the 'marker' style
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray tones are present except for subtle texture
Check that the text is legible but looks manually written
Verify the silhouette edges are jagged and not smooth
Confirm the central placement of all elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central, jagged black paper-cut silhouette with hand-drawn white internal details on a vast white textured field, anchored by a single line of raw, marker-style typography in a faint label box.
